_comment: Repository config: the suite lives in code/verification/. Relative paths are relative to this folder. The paper source and the v6-era data are not in this repository; point paper_root at a local copy of the paper to enable the claims checks.
_comment_script_paths: script_paths maps a script id to its real location when it is not under code_root (e.g. fig_v7_all.py before it is moved into v7jobs/).
_comment_v7: v7_out holds prod7/edge7/chiwR9v7/lam7/decomp7 (Mac: the v7jobs folder itself); v7_checks the convergence-check jsons (c2/c3/c4); v7_figs the fig_v7_all.py output (numbers_v7.json). Set paper_root to the folder of the tagged paper source.
